llm_response.reason: The website mimics a popular gaming event (PUBG MOBILE) with a countdown timer and reward collection prompts to create a sense of urgency. It encourages users to log in via social platforms—a tactic commonly used to phish for user credentials. These elements align with common scam characteristics, such as impersonation and urgency, despite not being a traditional online shopping portal. This places the site in the Fake Online Shopping scam category as it deceptively lures users into providing sensitive personal information.
